notes: Regime labels are visible to the offline readout only. At all times the graph retains its own hidden units, node traces, weights and bias. The readout uses one state and fixed birth parameters for graph energy, standardized on an independent calibration bank. The primary pair is combined features at the two matched-X snapshots with 8 earlier visits per object, and two-stage Bonferroni intervals. Secondary modes reuse the same diagnosis. External readout output never affects a motor or a graph write.
